summary: Role Eligibility System testing complete. All 14 backend tests passed. The strict role filtering system is working correctly: RN seekers only see RN jobs, CNA seekers are blocked from liking RN-only jobs (403), express-interest and pipeline stage updates reject ineligible candidates (403), job creation auto-populates primary_role_category from specialty, and accepted_role_categories array is saved correctly. Frontend job form has Role Category (required) and Also Accept (optional) dropdowns with correct data-testid attributes.

Backend: GET /api/swipe/jobs for RN seeker returns ONLY jobs with RN in accepted_role_categories
Backend: GET /api/swipe/jobs does NOT return CNA-only or LPN-only jobs to RN seeker
Backend: POST /api/swipe (like) rejects RN seeker liking CNA-only job with 403
Backend: POST /api/employer/express-interest rejects expressing interest in ineligible candidate with 403
Backend: PUT /api/pipeline/candidates/{id}/{job}/stage rejects ineligible candidate with 403
Backend: POST /api/jobs auto-populates primary_role_category='RN' from specialty 'Registered Nurse (RN) - ICU/Critical Care'
Backend: Migration populated primary_role_category and accepted_role_categories on existing jobs
Backend: Migration populated normalized_role_category='RN' on RN seeker profile
Backend: GET /api/swipe/seekers filters ineligible seekers from employer view

context_for_next_testing_agent: Role eligibility system is fully implemented and tested. Key points: (1) check_role_eligibility() in eligibility.py is the single source of truth, (2) All endpoints (swipe/jobs, swipe/seekers, swipe action, express-interest, accept-candidate, pipeline stage update, match creation, offer creation) call check_role_eligibility() BEFORE any scoring, (3) Jobs have primary_role_category and accepted_role_categories fields, (4) Seeker profiles have normalized_role_category field, (5) Frontend job form has Role Category (required) and Also Accept (optional) dropdowns with data-testid attributes.
